WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'review' THEN 'Reviews'

WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'kickoff' OR title_lower CONTAINS 'kick-off' THEN 'Kickoffs'
WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'planning' THEN 'Planning'
WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'standup' OR title_lower CONTAINS 'stand-up' THEN 'Standups'
WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'sync' OR title_lower CONTAINS 'synchronization' THEN 'Sync Meetings'
WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'training' THEN 'Training'
WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'presentation' THEN 'Presentations'
WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'discussion' THEN 'Discussions'
WHEN title_lower CONTAINS 'meeting' THEN 'General Meetings'
ELSE 'Other'
END AS subject_type
WITH subject_type, count(*) AS meeting_count
ORDER BY meeting_count DESC
LIMIT 5
RETURN subject_type, meeting_count
